# v0.2.0-beta.1 validation record

**Note:** This file was generated by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol under the direction of Adam Phillippy.

This record belongs to the local `v0.2.0-beta.1` release candidate. The tested source
commit is `7695b3125935d81fa39a162ba84a1a82b2bed94d`; the annotated tag contains only
this evidence and release-document updates beyond that source state.

* macOS 26.5.2 (25F84), arm64

* wasm-pack 0.15.0, wasm-bindgen 0.2.127, wasm-opt 117

## Release commands

```sh
cargo fmt --all --check

cargo test --workspace
cargo check -p moddotplot-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
npm --prefix web ci
npm --prefix web run verify
npm --prefix web run test:e2e:chrome
cargo test -p moddotplot-core --test estimator_validation \

```

## Automated coverage

* 48 regular Rust tests passed; two explicit scientific benchmarks are ignored by
  normal CI and run separately for release evidence.
* 20 TypeScript unit tests passed.
* Eight real-Wasm application tests passed in each of Chromium, Firefox, WebKit, and
  installed Google Chrome: 32 browser-test executions total.
* The browser suite covers initial exact dispatch, absence of external network egress,
  transactional replacement/clear, keyboard navigation, WebGL context restoration,
  resize, worker crash/reload, progressive detailed paint, pairwise/orientation/reset, gzip,
  ambiguity, absence of feature-import UI, and recoverable allocation rejection.
* Renderer cache selection has focused unit coverage. A repeated full-chromosome
  pan/zoom/reset trace plateaued at `Memory ~391.5 MiB` in both cycles.
* `npm audit --audit-level=moderate` reported zero known vulnerabilities on
  2026-08-29. This registry result is time-sensitive.

Two independent local clones installed the lockfile, ran the complete release build,
and produced byte-identical static assets. The local packaging preflight then produced
separate source and web archives, verified all SHA-256 entries, and confirmed the web
archive contained the license, notices, dependency-license bundle, SBOM, citation
metadata, user/scientific documentation, and deployable assets. The packaging script
was hardened during this gate to reject generated-file drift and duplicate tar entries.

## Scientific report

The bounded 30-configuration estimator/HLL sweep completed successfully. The raw TSV
is [estimator-validation.tsv](estimator-validation.tsv). It covers verified-winner and
legacy statistics, registers 256/1,024/2,048, HLL p8–p12, multiple ntHash2 layouts,
80–99% mutation, periodic repeats, cardinality imbalance, threshold/spatial metrics,
runtime, and full-winner fingerprint discrepancies.

For the selected 1,024-register/HLL p10 configuration, verified winners had mean
absolute ANI error `0.008108`, P95 absolute error `0.025736`, and bias `-0.004412` on
the bounded fixture. No 32-bit/full-winner discrepancy was observed anywhere in the
sweep. These results validate the release decision but are not universal biological
accuracy guarantees.

## Chromosome-scale browser report

Inputs were downloaded from NCBI EFetch and validated by sequence length and SHA-256:

| Input | Bases | FASTA SHA-256 |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| T2T-CHM13v2.0 chr1, `NC_060925.1` | 248,387,328 | `8471eac90037b6886d110288712bb46b2af620e47965a672a7d1555ba0e36c4f` |
| HG002 v1.1 paternal chr1, `CP139546.2` | 252,060,741 | `8cc00c7b8b4a96adb1a71f16524ab4aff166648eae427724cb99d612c2db9041` |

Default parameters were k=21, 1,000 overview cells, 256 quick registers, 1,024
detailed registers, and sparse correction off.

| Measurement | CHM13 self | CHM13 × HG002 paternal |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Sequence loading | 2.14 s | 4.28 s for both records |
| First preview tile | 2.96 s from input / 0.83 s after load | 0.60 s after pair selection |
| Coherent quick view | 4.78 s | 5.47 s |
| First refined tile | 5.45 s | 6.83 s |
| Stable refined viewport | 7.59 s | 11.15 s |
| Reported final application memory | ~155.5 MiB | ~253.8 MiB |

Cancelling a 4,096-register detailed pairwise build by zooming produced the first
replacement 8,000-cell preview tile in 1.03 seconds. No unexpected network request was
observed. Raw values are in [browser-performance.json](browser-performance.json).

The application memory value combines Wasm estimates and retained CPU/GPU tile bytes;
it is not whole-process resident memory. JavaScript heap is reported separately in the
raw record. Temporary allocation peaks and graphics-driver overhead are not available
through a portable browser API, so the table deliberately does not call the estimate a
complete process peak.

## Boundaries and interpretation

This beta passes its bounded correctness, orchestration, resource, cross-engine, and
reproducibility gates. It remains a functional preview because the broader
preregistered biological/indel/repeat validation grid, stable numeric/pixel goldens,
and robust sharded one-billion-base design are future work. No external deployment or
publication was attempted.
